convention: decision-frame convention v2 (docs/MLB_BROADCAST_TIMING.md: earliest 0.25 s grid frame with live shot + pitcher still on the rubber + batter in the box + readable bug, continuous until motion)
status: All 19 PA79-82 rows directly reviewed and merged on 2026-09-26 to 2026-09-27: 17 annotated, 2 unavailable. No candidates remain. See merge_history and game_747139_timing_verification_pa79_82.json.
produced_by: PA79-80: prior Claude candidates, retained verdicts and Codex direct verification/corrections. PA81-82: Codex subagent direct frame annotation followed by main-session timing/scoreboard image review, 2026-09-26 to 2026-09-27.

annotator_problems: At the decision frame 8180.25 the bug's second banner line is blank, so '4. OLSON' is not readable there; I read the batter banner '4. OLSON  1-4' on the same unbroken shot at 8181.50 through 8183.75 and used that for identity. P:21 IS readable at 8180.25.

Motion start 8183.70 is the first frame with a barely-begun front-leg lift; the preceding frame 8183.65 is unambiguously still and 8183.80 is an unambiguous knee lift, so the motion start could be 8183.70 +/- 0.05 s. This does not affect the decision frame, which is far earlier.
Release is a manual estimate: at 8184.90 the ball already shows a small gap from the fingertips, so true release may be a frame earlier (~8184.87). Reported with uncertainty 0.15 s as required.

The shot cut at 8180.10-8180.25 is very close to the decision frame, so the valid pre-pitch window is only about 3.45 s long (8180.25 to 8183.70). I searched back past the cut and confirmed the earlier shot (8180.00, 8180.10) is a batter-less close-up of Diaz, i.e. the window genuinely cannot start earlier.
79.end_of_pa_evidence: Pitch 1 was put in play. At 8186.00 the bug banner is mid-refresh showing a partial speed readout ('MPH' / 'P') and the batter's follow-through is visible; at 8189.00 the banner reads 'DIAZ  94 MPH' with the bug still at 0 outs and P:21 (the bug lags), and the picture is a wide outfield shot with a Mets fielder settling under the ball and the batter-runner heading up the line. By 8192.00 the bug has updated to NYM 8 / ATL 7, bases empty, down-arrow 9, ONE gold out circle (0 outs -> 1 out), 0-0, 'DIAZ  P:22' (pitch count 21 -> 22), while a Mets fielder (#12) is shown making/completing the catch in shallow left-centre. The same 1-out, P:22, bases-empty, NYM 8 / ATL 7 bug persists at 8195.00, 8198.00 and 8201.00, over shots of Olson (#28, Braves) walking back into the Braves dugout and the Braves manager in the dugout. That confirms PA 79 ended on pitch 1 as a field out with 1 out recorded and no runner reaching, and that PA 80 begins after 8201.

annotator_problems: Pitch 7 has no valid v2 decision frame. The broadcast stays on close-ups of Diaz (8302.00, 8302.50, 8303.00, 8303.10, 8303.25, 8303.30 - the last four an extreme head-and-glove shot showing neither the rubber nor the batter) until the cut at ~8303.33, and the first live wide frame (8303.35) already shows the leg lift. Grid points 8303.00/8303.25 fail condition (1) and 8303.50 fails condition (2), so the row is marked unavailable. I kept release_seconds and motion_start_seconds populated for that row because I directly observed them; only the decision fields are null.

Pitch 2 is limited by the batter, not by the shot. The live centre-field camera is back by 8221.00 and Diaz has both feet planted at the rubber from 8222.00, but White is out of the box with the bat lowered at 8222.00/8223.00/8223.25, stepping in with the bat tip down at 8223.50, and bent over the plate digging in at 8223.75, so condition (3) is what fails at the previous grid point.

The batter second line on the bug is not shown for the first two pitches. At the pitch 1 decision frame (8216.00) and the pitch 2 decision frame (8224.00) the bug has only the DIAZ banner row; the '5. WHITE   HBP' second line first appears from about 8230 onward, so batter_banner_seen is null for pitches 1 and 2.

At the pitch 2 decision frame the banner is cycling the previous pitch's speed ('96 MPH') rather than the pitch count, so P:23 was read from the nearby frames 8226.00, 8227.50 and 8228.00 and not from the decision frame itself.

Several decision frames sit only a short time before the motion start because of long between-pitch close-ups of Diaz: pitch 6 has only 0.50 s of valid pre-motion window (8289.50 to 8290.00) and pitch 5 only 1.75 s (8274.25 to 8276.00). These are genuine, not search artefacts - I sampled back through the cut in each case.

Release times are manual estimates. Each is the midpoint of a 0.10 s bracket between the last frame with the ball still in the hand at high cock and the first frame with the arm through and the hand empty; I did not resolve them to the video's individual 1/30 s frames, hence uncertainty 0.15 s on every row.

Bug lag is not uniform and should not be used as a timing cross-check. The speed readout appears about 1.0 s after release (pitch 1 released 8218.75, '96 MPH' already up at 8219.80) while the count digits lag 2-4 s (pitch 6 released 8291.05, count still 2-2 at 8292.20 and only 3-2 by 8296.00). The pitch clock also freezes during the delivery (:07 held from 8217.00 through 8219.20 on pitch 1).

After the last pitch the broadcast shows a player captioned 'WHITE 36' at the Braves dugout rail being congratulated at 8312.00 and 8314.00 while the bug simultaneously shows a runner on first. I could not tell from these frames whether White stayed at first or was replaced by a pinch-runner; I report only what the bug shows and flag the dugout shots as unexplained.
80.end_of_pa_evidence: Pitch 7 is put in play: at 8305.00 the bat is blurred through the swing and at 8305.40 White is out of the box running, with the bug reading 3-2 / DIAZ 90 MPH. The high camera at 8306.00 and 8308.00 shows the ball dropping in front of the converging outfielders in shallow left-centre while the bug still reads 3-2 with 1 out and no runners. The bug flips at 8310.00: it reads NYM 8 / ATL 7, down-9, 1 out (one gold circle, one open), the lower-right diamond gold (runner on 1B), count 0-0, banner 'DIAZ  90 MPH' - the single that ends PA 80. At 8312.00, 8314.00 and 8316.00 the same bug reads 0-0 with the runner on 1B, 1 out, and the banner has advanced to 'DIAZ  P:29', confirming PA 81 has begun. Note that the 8312.00 and 8314.00 shots are dugout cutaways in which a player captioned 'WHITE 36' is at the Braves rail being congratulated, which I cannot reconcile with him standing on first; I report the bug reading and flag the discrepancy rather than interpreting it.
